name: mobile-sensor-meter
description: PNDS score project that meters the phone's sensors: phones actively capture tilt (alpha/beta/gamma), motion (acceleration, shake), microphone level (RMS/peak/dBFS) and hand pose (local ml5.js HandPose keypoints) on-device and stream the processed values to the monitor over Socket.IO.
